body: From your note "redo the monkey like the capybara; movement looks bad; kinds like the bears, one model, colour only; lemurs too". Built from real small-monkey and lemur proportions, then the game style on top (head 1.5x real, big shiny eyes, ink outlines). Stands on all fours; each leg swings from the shoulder or hip, so walking looks right (last picture: mid-stride). Long tail that curls at the tip. Kinds you kept (only colours change): brown capuchin, white-faced capuchin, squirrel monkey, vervet, ring-tailed lemur, red ruffed lemur, black-and-white ruffed lemur, classic brown. Golden spider monkey dropped (your decision, 30 Oct).

comments.text: New monkey from real proportions, 9 kinds as colours on one model, built for walking. Viewer: 3 passes, last 8/10, nothing above minor left.
Golden spider monkey (your Redo): real Geoffroy's colours: golden body, black hands, feet, lower legs and tail tip, dark face with pale eye rings and muzzle. Other kinds unchanged.
Golden spider monkey dropped on your word. The 8 kinds you kept are recorded as Keep; the Monkey card is decided.
Approved: you decided it in Model Compare (31 Oct).
